Frequently asked questions

What is an agreement in principle?

An AIP is a conditional indication of what a lender might lend based on initial checks. It helps when making offers—not a guarantee of final approval.

Do I need a survey?

Your lender conducts a valuation. A homebuyer survey or full structural survey is optional but often recommended for peace of mind.
